product.amstrad-pc7386sx.summary: The Super VGA tier of the PC7000 range whose main unit was also used in the MegaPC.
product.amstrad-pc7386sx.history: Documented by an October 1992 service manual and a November advertisement, the PC7386SX accompanied the PC7286 in Amstrad’s offering for beginners. It added a 386SX and Super VGA, with 40 and 80 MB disk options. Amstrad supplied DOS 5, Desktop and Lotus Works 3.0. Its main unit continued in the MegaPC: that machine’s manual explicitly refers to the PC7386SX manual for this section. This does not make the two products the same machine. In January 1993, Computers by Post advertised the 1 MB/40 MB version with a colour monitor for £609 excluding VAT; this is a dealer price, not a launch price.
product.amstrad-pc7386sx.technical.marke: There were two starting configurations. The manual pairs 1 MB with a 40 MB disk and 2 MB with an 80 MB disk; both use a 25 MHz 386SX. The series-wide advertisement’s starting price is not assigned to this model. The January 1993 PCW advertisement names Counterpoint, while Amstrad and PC Review name Desktop; both attributions are retained without inferring revisions.
product.amstrad-pc7386sx.technical.hardw: Expansion is documented in the manual. Four SIMM sockets support up to 16 MB; video starts at 256 KB, expandable to 512 KB. It includes two 16-bit ISA slots, two RS-232C ports, parallel and PS/2 keyboard and mouse connections.
product.amstrad-pc7386sx.technical.firmw: An attributable PC7386SX dump is still missing. The manual’s board drawing labels BIOS LOW and BIOS HIGH on two 27C512 devices; preserved MegaPC ROMs are not reclassified as this model’s own firmware.
product.amstrad-pc7386sx.technical.verif: The internal alias does not validate this computer. BluMach 88f74ba3 lists “Amstrad PC7386” as an alias of megapc and uses MegaPC ROMs; it has no independent pc7386sx entry.
product.amstrad-pc7386sx.technical.limit: Validating the model requires its ROMs and dedicated tests. The documented MegaPC relationship does not prove identical BIOS images; revision comparison and booting in BluMach remain pending.
product.amstrad-pc7386sx.warning: Historical card under research; booting is not validated in BluMach.
